text: SEMKIT-012, lemmatize fallback: the epic E-002 says «by default the word stays as it is, as in the add-in», but the v1 default (ADR 0003) already asks pymorphy3 for a word its dictionary knows («лайфхаками» → «лайфхак», case lemmatize-unknown-pymorphy). The task says «by default nothing changes», so I kept the v1 default; fallback='pymorphy' adds the pymorphy3 guess for a word unknown to both dictionaries («тиктокерами» → «тиктокер»). If the default must be the add-in's (the word as it is), that is a change of ADR 0003 and of the morph cases: a separate task.
note: Keep the v1 default (ADR 0003: pymorphy3 for a word the bundled dictionary does not know) — better lemmas than the add-in's word-as-is; fallback='pymorphy' as you did. The epic line «the word stays as it is» is outdated by ADR 0003; no separate task.
